one_liner: Hosted SaaS ecommerce platform with REST/GraphQL APIs for storefronts and admin.

auth.notes: Store-level API accounts issue a static X-Auth-Token (API key style); app-level/public apps use the OAuth2 install flow to obtain a merchant access token sent in the same X-Auth-Token header.

access.notes: BigCommerce offers free trial stores for development/sandbox use; did not confirm an indefinite free dev-store option this pass. Public apps listed in the App Marketplace go through a technical review.

api.notes: BigCommerce exposes both a large REST API surface and a GraphQL Storefront API. MCP availability not confirmed this pass.

verdict.rationale: OAuth2 and a broad API exist, but acting on arbitrary merchants' stores in production requires marketplace app review.
